plain: To ask again and again, urgently.

webster.text: To request with urgency; to press with solicitation; to urge with frequent or unceasing application.

more.text: Pressing in request; urgent; troublesome by frequent demands; vexatious; unreasonable.

example.quote: The importance of commerce, in the view of revenue alone, must effectually guard it against the enmity of a body which would be continually importuned in its favor, by the urgent calls of public necessity.
